title: Decision: client-driven Chat unbind (draft binding vs F-Q1)
description: Conflict: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7) has the server unbind a roomed Chat when it stores a commit removing every one of the account's clients. A mimid follower keeps no ratchet tree (decision F-Q1, mimid-1wgh.7.2), so it cannot map Remove leaf indices to the account's clients. Readings: (a) followers track the tree (revisit F-Q1); (b) the client, which processes the commit and knows it was removed, tells the server via JMAP and the server then unbinds. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): (b) client-driven unbind; F-Q1 stands. The draft text must change to allow it; Mark edits the draft (jmap-chat-spec writes need his approval). The JMAP shape of the unbind signal is decided when the JMAP layer (.12) is planned.
